title: SR risk-budget optimization on frozen 2020-2026 inputs

decision.reason: All 11 candidates failed positive development AND validation returns. The provisional channel60 later check also lost; no retuning after inspection.

rounds.selection_rule: Select using development and validation only. Prefer positive net returns in both, drawdown under 12%, more trades than baseline, unchanged risk budgets; later_check evaluated once after selection. Reject adverse cost stress. Report all tested variants.
rounds.limitations: The full baseline results were already seen. Later_check is not a certified untouched holdout. Fixed current watchlist and rebased execution-price limitations persist.

rounds.reason: All initial candidates lost in 2023-2024 validation. Test lag in the broad-market slope filter and stricter stock trend quality. No later_check results have been generated for any candidate.
rounds.selection_rule: Same positive development AND validation return, drawdown under 12%, unchanged risk budgets. Do not inspect later_check before selection.

rounds.reason: Market slope removal increased false entries. Separately test applying the unchanged broad-market gate only to entries; use stock stops/targets/time/portfolio halt for exits. Compare a 60-day breakout channel against 20-day levels. Separately test longer targets/holding without widening initial/trailing stops.
rounds.selection_rule: Positive development AND validation net return, each max drawdown under 12%, more fills than baseline. Cost stress must remain positive in both periods before later_check. If none qualifies, report no validated selection; do not relax criteria.

selection_before_later_check.reason: No candidate met the declared positive-return gate in both development and validation. Channel60 is a provisional comparison only: one signal flag change, higher development return and lower validation loss/drawdown than baseline and breakout. It is NOT an accepted profitable strategy. No retuning after later_check.

input_sources.reason: Native Tencent Shenhua qfq contains nonpositive OHLC on 2020-03-19/23. Uniform hfq rebasing is used for all eight stocks, with original parameters unchanged.
limitations: Execution in rebased adjusted prices remains approximate; no corporate-action ledger.
Terminal-date scaling affects absolute price filters and lot sizes; this is not a point-in-time raw-price backtest.
Baseline full history already inspected; later_check is not certified untouched OOS.
Three adaptive rounds reuse validation; 11 configurations including baseline.
Fixed eight-stock watchlist creates membership/survivorship bias.
All stocks use hfq scaled by terminal qfq reference, not native qfq.
Terminal scaling affects price filters and 100-share sizing; no raw-price/corporate-action ledger.
CSI 300 is a price index; no common explicit dividend-reinvestment ledger.
No interest credited on cash. Sharpe subtracts 3% per year, using 244 sessions/year.
Periods restart from cash; full-period yearly metrics slice a continuous path.
Stress changes fill eligibility and quantities; trade paths can differ.
No candidate is approved for live trading or guaranteed profitability.
